title: Webb County Contractor Found Dead Between Rio Bravo and El Cenizo; Identified as John Wesley Hammack Jr., 35
excerpt: A third-party contractor performing work for Webb County was found dead Friday, Nov. 20, in the area between Rio Bravo and El Cenizo. The Webb County Sheriff’s Office identified him Saturday as John Wesley Hammack Jr., 35, and said the investigation remains ongoing.
content:
A third-party contractor performing work for Webb County was found dead in the area between Rio Bravo and El Cenizo, the Webb County Sheriff’s Office said, according to KGNS.

Deputies responded to a call about a deceased man in the area at approximately 5:56 p.m. Friday, Nov. 20. The fire department was also notified because of a possible hazardous materials concern, the sheriff’s office said.

Rio Bravo Mayor Amanda Perez Aguero said the man was a contractor for the Webb County Utilities Department, and that the Rio Bravo fire chief informed her of the death. Aguero said electrocution or asphyxiation were possible causes of death, and that a medical examiner will determine the cause.

The sheriff’s office said the investigation remains active and in its preliminary stages. Sheriff Martin Cuellar extended condolences to the man’s family and loved ones.

The sheriff’s office said in an update Saturday, Nov. 21, that the man is John Wesley Hammock, 35. The sheriff’s office said the investigation remains ongoing, and that additional information will be released as it becomes available.

Update — November 23, 2026: The Eagle Pass Business Journal, reporting the family's funeral arrangements, gives the man's name as John Wesley Hammack Jr., 35, of Eagle Pass — correcting the “Hammock” spelling in the sheriff's office's Nov. 21 identification as reported by KGNS. Visitation is scheduled for Friday, Nov. 27, from 2 to 8 p.m., with a rosary at 7 p.m., at Yeager Barrera Mortuary, and a second visitation Saturday, Nov. 28, from 10 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. The funeral service is scheduled for 2 p.m. Saturday at Saint Joseph Catholic Church, followed by interment at Our Lady of Refuge Catholic Cemetery in Eagle Pass. The sheriff's office said the investigation remains ongoing; no cause of death has been released.

Sources: KGNS — “Webb County contractor found dead between Rio Bravo and El Cenizo, sheriff’s office says”, https://www.kgns.tv/2026/11/21/webb-county-contractor-found-dead-between-rio-bravo-el-cenizo-sheriffs-office-says/; KGNS — “Deceased man found between Rio Bravo and El Cenizo identified”, https://www.kgns.tv/2026/11/21/deceased-man-found-between-rio-bravo-el-cenizo-identified/; Eagle Pass Business Journal — “Maverick County Man Found Dead at Webb County Jobsite, Case Under Investigation”, https://www.epbusinessjournal.com/2026/11/maverick-county-man-found-dead-at-webb-county-jobsite-case-under-investigation/
